name: Plunge Edge
description: The Plunge Edge is a split-system unit defined by its clean lines and modern, structured design. This separation allows you the flexibility to place the required Frostonic Chiller unit remotely, maximizing space efficiency in your dedicated recovery area. This robust tub offers a powerful, focused immersion experience. Note: The Plunge Edge requires a dedicated Frostonic PowerChiller for operation.
